- Live-demo voice: two minute-by-minute scripts (standard 6-minute demo + 2-minute lightning), 3 signal lines (setup / problem / payoff), and fallback lines for time or infra issues.
- Creative: simple hero image and brand-safe moodboard for the booth.

Thanks Jonas — PDF or single-slide PDF both work; most sponsors like a one‑pager PDF in the deck we share with buyers. Length constraints: 500 words max for the body, one quote, and one CTA link. For the live-demo voice, we ask for a short 2–3 line intro and one 10–15s closing remark for the session listing.

We have a small production review on Nov 25 at 10:00 PST — if you can get the stakeholder draft in by Nov 24 EOD that lets us queue it. Also: can you confirm whether you'll bring an engineer or product manager on stage? That determines things in the tech checklist.

—Marcy
